Dear ImGui v1.92.9b, unmodified core and SDL3/Vulkan backends.
The configuration header imconfig.h appends a thread_local current-context pointer (GImGui)
for asynchronous presentation; see its OpenRemix section.
Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/tree/v1.92.9b
Integration reference: examples/example_sdl3_vulkan/main.cpp at that tag.
See LICENSE.txt and SHA256SUMS. Vulkan shaders are embedded in the backend.
